references.text: God forbade Balaam from cursing Israel, which demonstrates God's protection over His people
Balaam acknowledges that he cannot go against the Lord's word, even for great riches
Balak confronts Balaam because he blessed Israel instead of cursing them
Balaam received a command to bless and could not reverse it
Balak's anger that Balaam blessed Israel three times instead of cursing them
Moses reminds Israel how God turned Balaam's curse into a blessing
Nehemiah refers to how God turned Balaam's curse into a blessing
Micah reminds the people of Balak's plans and Balaam's response to show God's salvation
